# OpenSCAD 3D Studio Plugin for Antigravity

A self-contained **Google Antigravity** plugin providing parametric OpenSCAD modeling skills, workspace rules, MCP tools, and an interactive **OpenSCAD 3D** live preview sidecar & standalone pop-out viewer.

## Features

- **Interactive Three.js Z-Up 3D Live Preview**:
  - Runs seamlessly inside Antigravity's Auxiliary Pane (`OpenSCAD 3D` sidecar) and as a standalone browser pop-out window.
  - **Multi-Color CMSH Mesh Rendering**: Faithful multi-part/multi-color visualization directly from OpenSCAD `color()` definitions.
  - **Live Playback Sidebar**: Dockable vertical sidebar tracking agent build steps (`stepIndex`/`totalSteps`), step summaries, code & parameter diffs, and smart camera framing (`focusBox`).
  - **Customizer Sliders & Presets**: Automatic UI controls parsed from `.scad` Customizer annotations with direct save-back into `.scad` files.
  - **Z-Section Slice Inspector & Build Plate Presets**: Real-time Z cross-section clipping slider, wireframe/edge toggles, and bed overlays (Auto, 180 mm Bambu A1 Mini, 256 mm P1/X1/P2S).
- **Automated Visual QA & Manifold Validation**:
  - `openscad_validate` & `openscad_preview` verify dimensions, bounding box, volume, facets, and watertight manifold status.
  - `openscad_render_views` renders multi-angle PNG snapshots (`iso`, `top`, `front`, `right`, etc.) for agent visual inspection.
- **Native STL & 3MF Export**: Export binary STL or multi-object 3MF (`lazyUnion`) directly from the UI or via `openscad_export`.
- **Automatic Library Discovery**: Automatically configures `OPENSCADPATH` for workspace `libraries/` and user library folders (`BOSL2`, `gridfinity-rebuilt`) across Windows, macOS, and Linux, preferring OpenSCAD Nightly (`Manifold` backend) when installed.

---

## Quick Installation

Because pre-built server bundles (`server/dist/` and `sidecars/openscad_3d/main.mjs`) are included in the repository, end users do **not** need to run `npm install` or build anything.

### Option 1: Antigravity CLI (Recommended)
```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/alexsoloman173-lgtm/antigravity-openscad-plugin
```

### Option 2: Manual Git Clone
Clone directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory:
- **macOS / Linux**:
  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/alexsoloman173-lgtm/antigravity-openscad-plugin ~/.gemini/config/plugins/openscad
  ```
- **Windows (PowerShell)**:
  ```powershell
  git clone https://github.com/alexsoloman173-lgtm/antigravity-openscad-plugin "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\openscad"
  ```

---

## Prerequisites

- **Node.js** `>= 18` (Node 20+ recommended)
- **OpenSCAD** installed (OpenSCAD Nightly / development snapshot is strongly recommended for fast `Manifold` and `--enable=lazy-union` support).
  - Or set the `OPENSCAD_BIN` environment variable to point to your OpenSCAD binary (`openscad.com`, `openscad.exe`, or `openscad`).
- *(Optional)* **BOSL2** or **gridfinity-rebuilt** installed in your OpenSCAD `libraries/` directory.

---

## Included Components

### MCP Tools (`openscad_studio`)
- `openscad_preview` — Compile a `.scad` script and stream the updated 3D mesh, playback metadata, stats, and parameters to the live viewer.
- `openscad_validate` — Headless syntax, bounding box, volume, facet count, and watertight manifold check.
- `openscad_render_views` — Render PNGs from preset camera angles for automated visual verification.
- `openscad_export` — Export `.stl` or `.3mf` (supports `lazyUnion` and `-D` parameter overrides).
- `openscad_list_files` — List `.scad` files in the workspace and inspect active OpenSCAD version/backend capabilities.

### Skill & Rules
- `skills/openscad/SKILL.md` — Agent skill with workflow best practices and references (`bosl2-cheatsheet.md`, `customizer.md`, `printing-bambu.md`).
- `rules/AGENTS.md` — Always-on workspace rules enforcing Manifold-friendly primitives, fast compilation, live preview streaming, and visual QA.

---

## Building from Source (Developers)

If you modify TypeScript or UI files under `server/src/`:

```bash
cd server
npm install
npm run build
```

This bundles `server/dist/server.mjs`, `server/dist/standalone.mjs`, `server/dist/preview.html`, and `sidecars/openscad_3d/main.mjs`.
